calls.statement:
SELECT status, fulfilment_type, login_state, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS d, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_date_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helsinki_count,
 COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS total_distinct
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-29' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03'
